description: WRITE: saves a new invoice as a DRAFT in A-Cube. Nothing is sent to the SDI until acube_send_draft_invoice. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two drafts. Validate first with acube_validate_invoice. POST /invoices/draft.

fattura_elettronica_body.description: Exactly one invoice body (an array with one object), snake_case keys: dati_generali (dati_generali_documento...), dati_beni_servizi (dettaglio_linee, dati_riepilogo), optional dati_pagamento. Field names as in the A-Cube Italy API reference.

fattura_elettronica_header.description: FatturaPA header as A-Cube JSON (snake_case keys): dati_trasmissione (codice_destinatario, pec_destinatario), cedente_prestatore (seller), cessionario_committente (buyer). Give the full header (seller and buyer) for a draft you intend to send: A-Cube only fills in transmission data automatically, and acube_validate_invoice shows what is missing.

annotations.title: Send a draft invoice to the SDI

description: WRITE: accepts a draft and transmits it to the Sistema di Interscambio. This is a legal act: a sent e-invoice cannot be recalled (only corrected with a credit note) and may be billed by A-Cube. Without confirm: true it only returns the draft for review. Show the draft to the user and get their explicit OK first. POST /invoices/draft/{uuid}/send.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually send. Otherwise the draft is returned as a preview.

name: acube_send_draft_invoice
title: Send a draft invoice to the SDI

description: Checks an invoice against the FatturaPA rules without creating or sending anything; returns the validation result or A-Cube's errors. POST /invoices/validate.

fattura_elettronica_body.description: Exactly one invoice body (an array with one object), snake_case keys: dati_generali (dati_generali_documento...), dati_beni_servizi (dettaglio_linee, dati_riepilogo), optional dati_pagamento. Field names as in the A-Cube Italy API reference.

fattura_elettronica_header.description: FatturaPA header as A-Cube JSON (snake_case keys): dati_trasmissione (codice_destinatario, pec_destinatario), cedente_prestatore (seller), cessionario_committente (buyer). Give the full header (seller and buyer) for a draft you intend to send: A-Cube only fills in transmission data automatically, and acube_validate_invoice shows what is missing.

name: acube_validate_invoice
